meeting_scene: As the team meeting began, Priya took a deep breath and spoke up first, her voice laced with a hint of exhaustion. "I don't think I've had a chance to share anything new recently - just feeling overwhelmed with our current projects and worried about meeting those deadlines." The room fell silent for a moment as her colleagues digested her words, before Alex stepped in, their bright smile instantly lifting the mood. "Actually, Priya, I was thinking we could work together on that project. We've got a great affinity going and it would be awesome to collaborate more closely." Sam nodded enthusiastically, his high morale clear for all to see as he chimed in with an idea about team-building activities, but before anyone else had a chance to respond, Jordan jumped in, their usually stoic demeanor giving way to a brief moment of humor.
